sn24.4:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati

sn24.4:2.1: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
